## ClaudeMC v1.6

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 · **Fabric Loader:** 0.16.5 · **Fabric API:** 0.100.7+1.21.1 · **Java:** 21

### New in v1.6

#### Server Info Screen
Passive server fingerprinting with vulnerability highlighting.

**How to open:** ClickGUI (`.`) → `[Server Info]` button in the footer bar.

**What it detects:**
- **Server brand** — intercepted from `minecraft:brand` payload packet (e.g. `Paper 1.21.1`, `Spigot`, `CraftBukkit`)
- **Plugin channels** — extracted from `minecraft:register` packets sent on join; most plugins register at least one channel revealing their name (e.g. `fadah:main`, `essentials:main`, `shopguiplus:update`)

**Vulnerability highlighting:**
Each detected brand/plugin is matched against a built-in database sourced from dupedb.net and public advisories:

| Colour | Severity |
|---|---|
| 🔴 Red stripe | CRITICAL — RCE / OP escalation |
| 🟠 Orange stripe | HIGH — item duplication, inventory exploit |
| 🟡 Yellow stripe | MEDIUM — info leak, minor bypass |
| ⚫ Grey stripe | PATCHED — was vulnerable, fixed version exists |
| 🟢 Green stripe | SAFE — no known vulnerabilities |

**Included in the DB:** FADAH, AuctionHouse (Kicjow), EssentialsX (vanish leak), CMI, ShopGUI+, Vault, LuckPerms, Geyser, Spigot, CraftBukkit, Paper, Purpur, BungeeCord, Waterfall, Velocity.

**[Search dupedb.net] button** — opens your browser directly to dupedb.net (pre-filtered by server brand when possible) for live, up-to-date exploit information.

Click any row in the list to expand a detail panel on the right showing affected versions, exploit description, and the patched version.
